firstAppearance.note: Original game year, distinct from the Remake appearance represented by this package.

galleryDescription.en: Bright and optimistic, Aerith brings an unguarded warmth to the people she meets. A flower seller from Midgar's Sector 5 slums, she tends the flowers at an old church and has an unusual ability to hear the planet's voice. Her gentle appearance is matched by a determined spirit, while her magic supports her companions in battle.
galleryDescription.zhCN: 艾莉丝天真开朗，总能以积极的态度温暖身边的人。她是在米德加五番街贫民窟生活的花商，时常到旧教堂照料花朵，并拥有聆听星球声音的特殊能力。温柔的外表下有着坚定的内心，她也会在战斗中以魔法支援伙伴。

combatStyle.en: Staff-wielding magic user who attacks with spells and supports allies.
combatStyle.zhCN: 以法杖和魔法攻击，并支援伙伴。
